stem: In the past the time, in minutes, taken by students to complete a certain challenge had mean 25.5 and standard deviation 5.2. A new challenge is devised and it is expected that students will take, on average, less than 25.5 minutes to complete this challenge. A random sample of 40 students is chosen and their mean time for the new challenge is found to be 23.7 minutes.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Assuming that the standard deviation of the time for the new challenge is 5.2 minutes, test at the 1% significance level whether the population mean time for the new challenge is less than 25.5 minutes.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: State, with a reason, whether it is possible that a Type I error was made in the test in part **(a)**.
